name: Vasukai Buzz
author: vasukai

sections.description:
Vasukai Buzz puts your reminders, offers and news on your visitors’ phones and computers through their browser.

  • One-tap opt-in box in the visitor’s language: English, Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Urdu, Arabic, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Indonesian and Turkish.
  • Uses your site’s own icon and colour, with a phone-friendly bottom sheet and dark mode.
  • Never asks on the first page view, and waits 30 days after a “Not now”.
  • Consent recorded word for word, a stop button on every notification, and export or delete for any subscriber (GDPR, UK GDPR, India’s DPDP Act, California’s CCPA).
  • WooCommerce: asks after an order, and can link buyers so you can send them reminders.
  • Write once and Buzz translates for each subscriber. Send now, schedule, or send by section of your site.
  • Nothing to upload: the plugin serves the worker file browsers need.

You need a free Vasukai account to send notifications: the plugin connects your site to the Vasukai Buzz service, described below.

External services

This plugin connects to Vasukai Buzz (https://www.vasukai.com/buzz), a web push notification service run by Vasukai. It is needed to show the opt-in box and to deliver notifications.

  • On every public page, visitors’ browsers load the Buzz script from https://www.vasukai.com/buzz/sdk.js with your site ID. The script counts page views in the browser (local storage) to decide when to show the box.
  • If a visitor allows notifications, their browser sends Vasukai its push notification address and keys, the topics shown, the exact consent wording, the visitor’s language, device and browser type, the page path and, from the request, the rough country. An IP address is used only as a one-way hash to limit spam and is not stored.
  • If you enter the identify secret and a signed-in user or WooCommerce buyer allows notifications, a one-way code made from their email is sent so you can send them reminders. The email itself is never sent.
  • When a notification is clicked or stopped, the browser tells Vasukai so it can count clicks and remove the subscription.

Vasukai terms: https://www.vasukai.com/terms
Vasukai privacy policy: https://www.vasukai.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In Vasukai, open Portal, Buzz notifications, and add your site (its https address).
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins, Add New Plugin, search for “Vasukai Buzz”, then click Install Now and Activate.
  3. Go to Settings, Vasukai Buzz and paste your Site ID. Optionally paste the identify secret to link signed-in customers.
sections.faq:
Does it work on iPhone?

Apple shows website notifications only for sites added to the home screen (iOS 16.4 and later). Buzz shows iPhone visitors how to do that.

My WordPress is in a subfolder.

Buzz switches to no-file mode automatically: the visitor finishes in a small Vasukai window and notifications come from Vasukai’s address with your site’s name and icon.
